results.text: Comparison of diltiazem and hydrochlorothiazide for treatment of patients 60 years of age or older with systemic hypertension. This randomized, double-blind, parallel design trial compared the efficacy and safety of monotherapy with either sustained-release diltiazem or hydrochlorothiazide in 61 men greater than or equal to 60 years of age with a diastolic blood pressure (BP) between 94 and 104 mm Hg.
